description: No repository at all: the declared fallback feature (advisory extraction and grounded summarisation) standing alone. Reachability must be reported as inconclusive rather than as an absence of findings.
advisory_text: In fastyaml before 2.2.0, the `unsafeLoad` function does not restrict which constructors a document may name, allowing remote code execution. Applications that call `safeLoad` are unaffected. Preconditions: the document must come from an untrusted source.
